add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(dpvoice.dll dpvoice.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dpvoice registry dpvoice.idl)

# dpvoice.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dpvoice-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dpvoice_shims OBJECT client.c main.c server.c)
target_link_libraries(dpvoice_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dpvoice_shims)
add_dependencies(dpvoice_shims wineheaders)
set(DPVOICE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dpvoice/dpvoice_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dpvoice dpvoice-cargo dpvoice.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dpvoice_shims psdk dpvoice_r ${DPVOICE_REUSED} uuid_sources)
